title: Add call-site listing default for signature or behavior changes
summary: Add one new entry to defaults.toml (governance file) requiring that jobs changing a function/type signature or behavior list every call site, found by whole-repo search, each as a deliverable with a covering test or an explicit exclusion, with the list carried in the change description for the verifier. Marked prose-only (or tested) and cited to this request.

defaults_applied.how: Entry wording is plain for outside readers.
Entry marked prose-only or backed by a test.
A test checks the default is actually selected and rendered.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: add a standing default to defaults.toml that the reader, producer and verifier briefs inherit; audience is Athena's agents and the user judging jobs.
Applies to code and tests classes, where signatures change; not docs.
Prose-only unless cheap mechanism exists; marked as such, like outcome-check.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml has a new [[default]] entry (e.g. id "call-sites") applying to ["code","tests"], with a source citing this request/job, stating: when a job changes a function's or type's signature or behavior, the reading or plan lists every call site found by searching the whole repo (not memory); each is a deliverable with a covering test or an explicit exclusion with reason; and the change description carries the list for the verifier.
The statement says whether it is enforced by mechanism or explicitly prose-only (mechanism default).
Run `cargo test` from the root: the repo_config test parses defaults.toml and all tests pass, including any test of rendered defaults; `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
A test (cargo test) shows the new default is selected for a code-class request and appears in the rendered defaults list given to the reader/producer, while it is absent for a docs-only request.
Docs mentioning the defaults list (CHANGELOG.md, and any design doc listing defaults) mention the new convention if they enumerate defaults.

out_of_scope: Building a tool that automatically searches call sites
hard_reason: Edits defaults.toml, the governance file that shapes every later job's briefs and verification.
